methodology: Synthetic English entries; seven original calibration entries and 22 held-out entries. BGE uses mean-pooled normalized embeddings, cosine similarity against the same activity examples as DeBERTa, max over synonyms and sentence chunks. Threshold selected only on calibration label F1, then exact matches, then fewer false positives. A second BGE variant requires cosine >= 0.7 and a calibrated positive-minus-negative margin, using four negative prototypes per activity example (negation, plans, someone else, historical activity). DeBERTa uses the app's fixed 0.85 threshold. Warm inference excludes model and reference loading. Small diagnostic benchmark, not a general accuracy estimate.
